items.item_text: Certifications in Fleet Management from NAFA or APWA.
Experience in Fleet Administration, Facilities Management, and Automotive or Transportation industry.
Experience interpreting, applying and communicating campus accounting policy and procedures to provide advice for management and exchange information.
Experience with University systems (M5, Tririga, Kuali, MyAggie)
Experience working with all areas of fleet services.
Knowledge of Fleet Management Information Systems and /or experience managing a fleet of 100 or more light or heavy vehicles.

Under general supervision, the Transportation Analyst provides high‑level data analytic support and project management to a broad scope of areas for the Transportation and Fleet Services department including but not limited to Business Resource Management, Physical Resources, Vendor and Financial Management, and Asset Management. The incumbent provides management and strategic support to Fleet and transportation services within the PATS department. Responsible for providing strategic and analytical support, making recommendations on fleet business processes to prevent, mitigate, and respond to customer issues. Develops and implements internal operational policies, procedures, guidelines, and controls. Interprets and applies university regulations, policies, and procedures pertaining to fleet metrics including vehicle utilization, life cycle cost effectiveness, replacement planning, sustainability, grant administration, and special projects. Performs in a lead capacity for Fleet Services operations in the absence of the Fleet Services Supervisor, ensuring continuity of operations, staff coordination and issue resolution. Develops business cases for a wide range of Fleet initiatives to support department leadership and provides recommendations to apply across the Health Campus. Creates specifications for reports and analysis based on business needs and required/available data elements and optimizes enterprise business intelligence tools.
Organizational and time management skills to effectively prioritize workload, handle multiple tasks, meeting multiple deadlines with frequent interruptions.
Skill to work independently and as part of a team to support management for decision-making and long range planning.
Knowledge of fleet maintenance and repair best practices, equipment types, functions, and procedures to ensure long asset life.

Knowledge of automotive and heavy equipment vehicles and equipment, their sub-assemblies, and general maintenance and repair techniques, tools and parts. Specifications development for new vehicles and equipment.
